## Summary

Scene classification is a core task in remote sensing. This paper systematically compares transfer-learning architectures, including convolutional neural networks and Vision Transformers, to identify which backbone performs best for classifying remote sensing scenes.

## Contribution

- Benchmarks multiple transfer-learning architectures on remote sensing scene classification.
- Provides a practical architecture-selection guide for practitioners and researchers working with aerial and satellite imagery.
